description: Writes a ready-to-send letter citing the right articles: GDPR requests (gdprAccess art. 15, gdprRectification art. 16, gdprErasure art. 17, gdprObjection art. 21, gdprPortability art. 20, gdprConsent art. 7(3)), a formalNotice to pay (in Romanian it cites art. 1522 Civil Code and art. 1014 CPC) or a powerOfAttorney, in any of 14 languages, as PDF, .docx or plain text. Fields left empty show as ________ and are listed in the reply.

fields.description: Document fields: gdprAccess: reference, copy (check), details (textarea); gdprRectification: reference, incorrect (textarea), correct (textarea); gdprErasure: reference, groundNotNeeded (check), groundConsent (check), groundObjection (check), groundUnlawful (check), details (textarea); gdprObjection: reference, marketing (check), reasons (textarea); gdprPortability: reference, newController; gdprConsent: processing, reference; formalNotice: amount (number), currency (currency), basis, dueDate (date), payDays (number), iban, interest (check); powerOfAttorney: agentName, agentAddress, agentId, powers (textarea), validUntil (date). Dates YYYY-MM-DD; check fields true/false; currency is an ISO code.

language.description: Language of the letter; default en

output.description: .pdf, .docx or .txt path; without it the text is returned

sender.description: Who writes (the principal, for a power of attorney)

id.description: ID document, power of attorney only

name: legal_letter
title: Legal letter
